name: SF Symbols
description: SF Symbols with a fallback when a symbol is missing on the running OS, accessible labels, and Reduce Motion aware symbol effects.

cost.note: Apple frameworks only; check the SF Symbols license for use outside Apple platforms

usage: Use `Image(systemName:)` or `Label(_:systemImage:)` for symbols that exist on the deployment target. For symbols added in later OS versions use `SymbolImage("name", fallback: "older.name")`, which shows the fallback instead of an empty image. Give icon-only buttons a text label. Animate with `.symbolBounce(trigger:)`, which does nothing under Reduce Motion.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify sf-symbols` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs), as an incremental Xcode build after a clean build of the other 39 modules. Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements and runtime behavior.
